_comment: The Grade 1 Science standalone lesson build, described for ../../mathematics/lesson-app-tools and built by ../lesson-kit. Order here IS the lesson number. These eight lessons are organised by the sub-strands of Cambridge Primary Science 0097 Stage 1, NOT by the six units of the course under science/grade-1/data, so progress is written under l01..l08 - see THE UNIT PROBLEM in wire-progress.py. The shell course was re-pointed from 0846 to 0097 on 2026-09-17, so the two now share a framework and STILL must not share progress keys: six units and eight lessons are different partitions of it, and emitting u01 would claim a whole unit was finished by one lesson. The app is also the vehicle that covers Stage 1 in full - the shell course reaches 22 of 35, because its six units are one per sub-strand of the 2018 framework.
subject: science
_sittings: Two sittings per lesson (validation v2, area 17): the lesson, then the games, home projects and quiz, with a break card between. Read by lesson-kit/_shell.py.
hubStrands: Ask questions, predict, sort, use equipment safely, measure in hands and cubes, record in tables, say whether it matched.
Living and never alive; what animals and plants need; parts of a plant; the body and the five senses; how people are alike and different.
Wood, metal, plastic, glass, rock, paper and fabric; object versus material; properties; squashing, bending, twisting and stretching.
How things move; pushes and pulls; floating and sinking; sources of sound and sound fading with distance; electricity and magnets.
Earth is our planet and mostly water; land is rock and soil; the Sun gives light and heat and is one of many stars.
How thinking has changed, how everyday things work, who uses science at work, and how what we do affects the world.
